Current-act apparatus41247 answers the body marker41226, and41449 answers the Pius V reference41403. Predecessor constitutions are incorporated by reference41230–41245, not independent outer acts. Disclose conventional sanction abbreviation41492 and printed notice41502 (Sequunlur  cardinalium  subscriptioncs.) promising cardinal subscriptions while omitting their list. The own papal body and papal subscription41499–41500 survive, but the absent named cardinal signature apparatus is a substantive source-extent omission rather than a conventional sanction formula; classify the preserved act as a fragment. Retain the surviving body, own subscription and printed notice; do not supply any names. Editorial date41503 retained with date null.
